ME bookkeeping identity |F_bot+F_top+dP| / tau*A (worst over all runs)
Ladd impulse identity sum_{c_q.n>0} c_q inj_q = rho_w u_w (relative)

impulse_identity.identity: sum_{q in UP} c_q inj_q = rho_w (cs^2 u_x, u_y)

fit_rate_vs_uw_n.note: per-step fluid-mass drift rate vs normal wall speed; slope is NOT -1 (i.e. not the naive rho*u_w*area source) and the drift is real, which is why u_w.n != 0 is out of contract
